summary.en: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, a frontier model for software development, knowledge work and science. It handles text, images, video, audio and PDFs with a 1M-token context, priced at $3/$15 per million input/output tokens, above earlier Gemini 4 models. It is the fourth new Gemini model in a month.

why.zh: Gemini 迭代节奏极快，并在编码场景上直接对标竞品。

summary.en: Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia CEO last week amid scandals; Colette Kress is interim CEO and the company projects revenue will keep growing. Nvidia's startup stakes have ballooned to about $65B with future deals in doubt, and critics balk at Huang's wish to return.
